title: Mika hình thái 1 · gồng chiêu (sheet cast)

focus.note: dựng kiếm trước mặt tập trung (đã duyệt)

style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Her braid, loose hair, scarf ends, ribbons and fox tail always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: T
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. From her diagonal guard she rotates the katana into a vertical position before her face, smoothly adjusting both hands to match the end reference, and closes her eyes in concentration; a gentle rising breeze lifts her hair, scarf and tail. Feet remain planted at the reference positions; no stepping, turning or scale change. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Wind or motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

segments.name: U
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. Holding the katana upright before her face with eyes closed, she opens her eyes while smoothly rotating the katana back into the diagonal guard shown in the end reference; the secondary motion of hair, scarf and tail gradually softens into a gentle idle sway, never freezing. Feet remain planted at the reference positions; no stepping, turning or scale change. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Wind or motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

game.code: cast plays on setSpriteAction duration (victory, buffs on forms without buff sheet)
game.plan: 24 khung: 0 = rest, 11 = focus (một khung duy nhất), 23 = rest; T đủ hai đầu, U bỏ khung focus đầu; cast phát đều theo duration của setSpriteAction

review: Codex spec 7/10 -> prompt T/U theo đề xuất
pick_note: Codex game 7.5: nối T->U sát khung mốc (T14 -> U1) để tóc/khăn/đuôi không đổi dáng đột ngột
